title: 第45章 别乱跑，明天班长去接你
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: 陆阳来到团部军人服务社，同时也解锁了部队新地图。军人服务社名字虽然高大上，但实际上就是个小超市，里头卖的东西也挺全乎，从吃的喝的，到日用小百货，什么毛巾牙刷脸盆应有尽有。可陆阳不是来买东西的，他是来打电话的。“你好，有人吗？”柜台前没人，陆阳便探头往里走了点，冲着货架区域问了一声。“想买点么斯东西呐，随便看。”一个略显富态的中年人操着江城口音，端着碗热腾腾的泡面，从吧台后头站起身。陆阳这才注意到，先前这个中年人应该是坐在一张小板凳上吃泡面。加上柜台有点儿高，所以他进来时才没瞧见。对方并没有穿着军装，而是披着厚厚的老旧军大衣，瞧着慈眉善目的丝毫不像军人。听说，部队里的军人服务社都是军属在开，所以陆阳一时间还真不知道该喊什么？但出于礼貌，他还是喊了声老板。“老板，我想打个电话，但是身上没有钱，可不可以挂个账，回头有机会我再给您送来？”陆阳有点尴尬，他是来这挂水的，哪里会想到带钱过来？老板把桌上的固定电话，推到他面前：“冒得事（没事），你尽管打，只要是内部线路都是补要钱滴。”陆阳喜上眉梢：“真哒？谢谢老板！”说罢他就拿起听筒，可刚准备拨号，手就忽然悬停在半空。“啷个了？”“额，我不知道号码......”“你是哪个单位，值班室电话不晓得？”“我是新兵连的。”“新兵连啊，你等我哈？”说罢，老板便从口袋里掏出一部翻盖手机，在通讯录里寻找了一下，接着用手机拨通电话。“喏，拿去，我这么斯单位的电话都有。”“谢谢。”陆阳没有多想，伸手接过后又不好意思的看了老板一眼。老板吸溜着泡面，笑着冲他摆手，表示不介意他到边上打。陆阳拿着电话来到角落里，那头电话就被接通，并传来值班人员的询问声。“你好，我是一排三班新兵陆阳，想找我们班长周凯东。”“陆阳？”值班员明显是知道陆阳的。因为这个兵，综合表现很不错，且多次被连长指导员表扬。同时，也是全连唯一一个淋了雨，感冒发烧去团部挂水的兵，属实是有点儿出名。陆阳借口说，自已这边缺东西，想让班长明天带人来复检时拿过来。那边也没多怀疑，让他稍微等一等，然后便去叫人了。大约过了两分钟，周凯东略带喘气的声音就出现在电话里。“陆阳，我是班长？”“你怎么样了，烧退了吗，感觉好点儿了吗，吃过饭了吗，哪儿来的电话？”听到周凯东一连串的关心，陆阳浑身暖洋洋的，立马就不冷了。都说班长是军中之母，在周凯东身上，他确实感受到了家的关怀。也更加坚定了要把班长留下的决心。“班长，我现在好多了，烧也退了，我是在团部军人服务社给你打的电话。”“我想跟你说一件事，你是个好班长，也是个好排长，丁腾飞的事不是你的错，不要自责和自我怀疑。”“等明天体检结束，我跟着你们一起回去，我会找机会和他好好谈谈，有矛盾咱们就解决矛盾，有问题就解决问题。”“最后，希望你今晚能开个班务会，和大家统一下口径；指导员明天要找大家谈话，只要有一个人说你不好，就得把你换掉。”“我不想你被撤掉，更不想换一个别的班长来，我觉得你比全连任何一个班长都要称职！”......“我知道了，谢谢你，陆阳。”“在那儿好好休息，别乱跑，明天班长去接你。”电话挂断，周凯东的眼眶已经有点儿红了。他没想到，陆阳拖着病殃殃的身体，还专程跑到小卖部打电话来跟自已说这些。这些鼓励，正是他现如今最最需要的，也是最好的安慰。“一排长，你眼睛怎么了？”“没事，进沙子了。”周凯东揉了揉润热的眼眶，转身从值班室走出来。外头的风，似乎不再那么冷冽，他的身体也像是被重新唤醒一样。周凯东回到训练场，发现三班新兵趁自已不在全都偷起懒，挤压许久的怒火顿时引爆。“要死啊一个个的，站都站不直？”“丁腾飞，你眼珠子转什么转，老子脸上有花啊？”“别练了，都别练了。全部给我上道，掐表计时！”“三公里跑不进十四分半的，中午饭都特么别吃了，我陪你们一块饿着！”新兵们被劈头盖脸的骂了一顿，胆战心惊的上跑道。看着吃了火药一样的周凯东，众人全然一副见了鬼的表情。先前明明还好好地，怎么去接了个电话，从前那个暴躁班长就又回来了？......另一头，陆阳挂断电话将手机还给老板，并说了声谢谢。刚要离开，就被老板叫住。“你这个新兵，还蛮讲义气。”“我请你吃个东西，店里的东西随便拿。”陆阳摇头拒绝，本来借用人家手机打电话就已经挺不好意思的，哪还能再拿人家东西？但老板却故意板着个脸，说要是不给他这个面子，就要问他要电话费。弄得陆阳没办法，只能象征性的拿了根火腿肠走。“谢谢老板，回头要是有机会，一定多带点人来光顾生意。”“一言为定啊，哈哈哈哈......”陆阳感慨部队还是好人多，要不怎么说，有困难找解放军叔叔？他刚掀开帘子，脚刚踏出门槛，忽然瞧见远处两个白色的东西在飘。目光聚焦，定睛一看，竟是两顶白色钢盔！陆阳赶紧把脚缩了回去，重新放下门帘。团部几乎看不到新兵，陆阳连个肩章都没有，出去实在太扎眼，肯定会被喊住盘问。正好月底了，鬼知道这帮人会不会拿他冲业绩，强行挑出个什么毛病出来？多一事，不如少一事，暂且避其锋芒最稳妥。“啷个了？”老板见他又退了回来，好奇询问。陆阳扭过头，尴尬的笑了笑。老板侧过身子，透过窗户朝外看了眼，瞧见两个白帽子纠察并肩走过。于是笑着指了指陆阳：“哈哈哈哈，你倒是还蛮灵醒（聪明）！”
content_en: Lu Yang came to the regimental military service club and also unlocked a new map for the army.Although the Military Service Club has a fancy name, it is actually just a small supermarket that sells a wide range of things, from food and drink to daily necessities, including towels, toothbrushes, and washbasins.But Lu Yang didn't come here to buy anything, he came to make a phone call."Hello, is there anyone?" There was no one in front of the counter, so Lu Yang went a little further in and asked towards the shelf area."You want to buy something, feel free to take a look." A slightly rich middle-aged man with a Jiangcheng accent stood up from behind the bar holding a bowl of hot instant noodles.Only then did Lu Yang notice that the middle-aged man was sitting on a small bench eating instant noodles.In addition, the counter was a bit high, so he didn't see it when he came in.The other party was not wearing a military uniform, but was wearing a thick old military coat. He looked kind-hearted and looked nothing like a soldier.I heard that the military service clubs in the army were run by military families, so Lu Yang didn't really know what to call for a while?But out of politeness, he still called the boss."Boss, I want to make a phone call, but I don't have any money. Can you place an account with me and I'll send it to you later when I have a chance?" Lu Yang was a little embarrassed. He was here to hang out, so how could he have thought of bringing money?The boss pushed the landline phone on the table in front of him: "It's risky (it's okay), you can call it. As long as it's an internal line, you'll have to pay for it." Lu Yang said with joy, "Really? Thank you, boss!" After saying that, he picked up the receiver, but just as he was about to dial, his hand suddenly hovered in mid-air."What?" "Um, I don't know the number..." "Which unit are you from? Don't you know the phone number of the duty room?" "I'm from the recruit company." "Recruit company, are you waiting for me?" After that, the boss took out a flip phone from his pocket, searched for it in the address book, and then made a call with his mobile phone."Here, take it, I have the phone number of my employer." "Thank you." Lu Yang didn't think much, stretched out his hand to take it, and then looked at the boss sheepishly.The boss sipped the instant noodles, smiled and waved to him, indicating that he didn't mind if he came to the side to beat him.Lu Yang took the phone and came to the corner. The phone on the other end was connected, and there was a question from the person on duty."Hello, I'm Lu Yang, a recruit from Platoon 3, and I'd like to see our squad leader Zhou Kaidong." "Lu Yang?" The person on duty obviously knew Lu Yang.Because of this soldier, his overall performance is very good and he has been praised by the company commander and instructor many times.At the same time, he was also the only soldier in the company who went to the regiment headquarters to get wet when he got caught in the rain, caught a cold or had a fever, so he was somewhat famous.Lu Yang made an excuse that he was short of something and wanted the squad leader to bring it to him when he brings someone for re-examination tomorrow.There was no doubt on the other side, so they asked him to wait for a while, and then went to call someone.About two minutes later, Zhou Kaidong's slightly breathy voice appeared on the phone."Lu Yang, I'm the monitor?" "How are you? Is your fever gone? Do you feel better? Have you eaten? Where did you call?" Hearing Zhou Kaidong's series of concerns, Lu Yang felt warm all over and immediately stopped feeling cold.It is said that the squad leader is the mother of the army. In Zhou Kaidong, he really felt the care of his family.He also became more determined to keep the squad leader."Squad leader, I'm much better now and my fever has gone away. I called you from the Military Service Club of the regiment." "I want to tell you one thing. You are a good squad leader and a good platoon leader. What happened to Ding Tengfei is not your fault. Don't blame yourself and doubt yourself." "When the physical examination is over tomorrow, I will go back with you. I will find an opportunity to have a good talk with him. If there are conflicts, we will resolve them and solve the problems if they arise." "Finally, I hope you can have a meeting tonight.Let's talk to everyone in the class meeting; the instructor will talk to everyone tomorrow.If anyone says something bad about you, you will have to be replaced. ""I don't want you to be removed, let alone another squad leader.I think you are more qualified than any squad leader in the company!"..."I understand, thank you, Lu Yang." "Have a good rest there, and don't run around.The squad leader will pick you up tomorrow." The phone was hung up, and Zhou Kaidong's eyes were already a little red.He didn't expect that Lu Yang, dragging his sick body, would make a special trip to the canteen to call him and tell him this.These encouragements are exactly what he needs most now and are also the best comfort."Platoon leader, what's wrong with your eyes?" "It's okay, there's sand in it." Zhou Kaidong rubbed his moist eyes, turned around and walked out of the duty room.The wind outside seemed no longer so cold, and his body seemed to be reawakened.Zhou Kaidong returned to the training ground and found that all the recruits in the third class were slacking off while he was away. The anger that had been suppressed for a long time suddenly exploded."You're all dying. You can't stand up straight?" "Ding Tengfei, why are your eyes rolling? I've got stains on my face?" "Stop practicing, don't practice at all. Get on the track and count the clocks!" "Those who can't run within 14 and a half minutes of the three-kilometer run don't even have lunch. I'll starve with you!" The recruits were scolded and walked onto the track in fear.Looking at Zhou Kaidong who was eating gunpowder, everyone looked as if they had seen a ghost.You were obviously fine before, but why did you answer the phone and the grumpy squad leader from before came back?...On the other end, Lu Yang hung up the phone and returned the phone to his boss, saying thank you.Just as he was about to leave, he was stopped by his boss."You, a new recruit, are quite loyal." "I'll treat you to something to eat, and you can take anything from the store." Lu Yang shook his head and refused. He was already embarrassed to borrow someone else's mobile phone to make calls, so how could he take something from someone else?But the boss deliberately kept a straight face and said that if he didn't give him this face, he would ask him for the phone bill.Lu Yang had no choice but to take a symbolic piece of ham and leave."Thank you, boss. If I have a chance later, I will definitely bring more people to patronize the business." "It's a deal, hahahaha..." Lu Yang lamented that there are still many good people in the army. How else can I talk to my uncle from the People's Liberation Army if I have any difficulties?As soon as he opened the curtain and stepped out of the threshold, he suddenly saw two white things floating in the distance.Focusing his eyes, he took a closer look and saw two white steel helmets!Lu Yang quickly retracted his feet and lowered the curtain again.There were almost no new recruits in the regiment headquarters, and Lu Yang didn't even have an epaulette. It was too conspicuous when he went out, and he would definitely be stopped and questioned.It's the end of the month, who knows if these people will use him to criticize his performance and forcefully find some fault?One more thing is worse than one less thing. It is safest to avoid its sharp edges for the time being."Are you yelling?" The boss asked curiously when he saw him retreating.Lu Yang turned his head and smiled awkwardly.The boss turned sideways, looked out through the window, and saw two white hat pickets walking side by side.So he smiled and pointed at Lu Yang: "Hahahaha, you are quite alert (smart)!"
